scope: Bounded screening of all 27 active registered editorial lines. Sources: 29 Oct BEA GDP and PCE, US Treasury, ECB, EU ECFIN, ICI money-market assets, EIA gas storage; 30 Oct BOJ decision; 28 Oct World Bank commodity outlook; WHO 23 Oct Bundibugyo update, FAO price-release schedule, WOAH animal-health guidance. Risk/attribution and vintage limitations preserved. Absence of new article is not proof of absence of global events.

reviewed_lines.note: MT-GM-2026-10-30 staged: BEA Q3 GDP +3.4% annualised versus September real DPI -0.3%, ECB hold, BOJ ETF-sale schedule, Treasury 29 Oct repricing.
ICI 29 Oct money-market assets $7.901tn, weekly change -$43.29bn; distinguish flow proxy, valuation, holdings and beneficial control. Weekly producer owns full assessment.
BOJ ETF disposal changes future Japanese market structure; Japan transition is already covered by country context and staged Atlas hypothesis, not a new national dossier.
US quarterly-versus-monthly demand and Japan policy normalization screened; no standalone country dossier with independently validated structural delta.
AI capex and earnings repricing examined as finance evidence; no new replicated technical capability or deployment stage proven by equity selloff.
AI equipment imports and cloud cash returns require verified utilization, customer revenues and commissioning; earnings disappointment is not a technology maturity transition.
World Bank October commodity scenario links Middle East conflict to energy and food supply; no independent new military operation or throughput measure verified for a separate conflict system.
BOJ ownership of ETF assets documented, but sale schedule is not transfer of control completed; no new full strategic actor profile justified.
ECB 29 Oct hold 2.50% deposit and BOJ 30 Oct hold 1.25% with separate ETF sales schedule; Fed 28 Oct decision background.
BOJ 30 Oct unanimous ETF sale acceleration from ¥330bn to ¥860bn annually from Jan 2027; distinguished from rate vote 8–1.
BOJ future sales cannot yet support an ex-post policy case; observe implementation and liquidity effects from January 2027.
BOJ reduction of public ETF holdings changes expected equity supply, but market-design consequences remain a hypothesis pending actual trading.
ICI money-market asset decline and BOJ future ETF sales are distinct cash/stock/control categories; no new monthly global control dataset.
No newly observed comparable annual beneficial ownership or strategic control data; do not extrapolate weekly money-fund assets.
BOJ and ECB operating mandates and asset-runoff decisions examined; no separate institutional system article beyond already documented mechanisms.
EU October sentiment and ECB decision do not constitute new regional integration agreement or settlement infrastructure.
AI infrastructure spending and technology shares do not measure worker displacement or productivity diffusion; no new verified social transformation.

World Bank 28 Oct projects 2026 food commodity prices +10% and 2027 +7%; FAO September food price index is latest completed monthly release. Pesticide exposure and regulation, healthy-diet affordability, farm productivity, nutrition and rural distribution screened; no fresh comparable exposure/outcome data supports separate article.

WOAH animal-health reporting standards, livestock management and veterinary antibiotic/AMR governance screened; no newly verified cross-border change in animal outbreak, antimicrobial use or chemical/biological weapons safeguards. Do not infer hazard equals exposure.

Middle East energy supply assumptions in World Bank baseline and adverse scenario screened. Major-power war remains conditional; no confirmed new military capability, attack attribution or physical throughput delta.

WHO 23 Oct Bundibugyo bulletin reports 9,704 confirmed cases in DRC as of 20 Oct; staged 26 Oct article has QA rejection. No independently newer situation report verified for another publication. Avoid equating imported cases with sustained spread outside documented clusters.
No new archival evidence affecting historical/intellectual research; recent political-economy and AI arguments are not new historical source material.
World Bank 28 Oct energy +32% forecast and EIA 29 Oct regional gas storage vintage screened; no newly commissioned energy system or independently confirmed capacity change.
Brazil post-election repricing was covered on 27 Oct; no newly verified fiscal decree, sovereign issuance change or investor attribution justifying another election article.
Commodity Outlook discusses energy, metals and food exposure; price forecasts do not document a new concession, resource ownership or sovereign control change.
AI equipment investment and energy price risks reviewed; no verified new cross-border grid operation, Itaipu governance change or commissioned data-centre electricity connection.
World Bank energy/food shipping risks screened; no primary verified new operational port, pipeline or corridor throughput delta. Distinguish insurance/price risk from actual closure.

selection_reason: Global Macro contains the material 29–30 Oct cross-asset and policy delta. BOJ ETF sales are a staged Atlas structural hypothesis, not an observed 2027 execution. World Bank commodity outlook is forecast rather than newly measured farm/health outcomes. WHO Bundibugyo subject already has a 26 Oct rejected staged article; no duplicate. No second theme meets primary-evidence and corpus-novelty gates.

European Commission business and consumer surveys
FAO Food Price Index release schedule

evidence_gaps: No new 30 Oct primary quantitative pesticide exposure or livestock antibiotic consumption series established.
No new WHO Bundibugyo bulletin after 23 Oct independently verified; earlier article remains under QA rejection.
No completed BOJ ETF sales at revised pace before Jan 2027.
No independent real-time Gulf oil shipping throughput or new war escalation confirmed.
